Karaoke and live sport in Pegeia

A little pub with a proper British feel, as one guest puts it. Pies, cocktails, karaoke every night and live sports events every day. On Google, 4.6 stars from 159 reviews.

Pub

Pub food, drinks and a night out

The chalkboard outside lists the food: chicken pie, pork pie with gravy, steak pie, scampi and wedges, chicken wings, mac and cheese sticks.

Pies and pub food

5 Google reviews mention the pies, 3 the chicken pie. One guest stopped by for lunch on holiday and found the food really tasty.

Karaoke every night

Cocktails and karaoke every night, says the chalkboard: just ask for it.

Live sport and bingo

Live sports events every day, says the board outside. At the bar: bingo on Monday, book your seat. 4 Google reviews mention quizzes.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Friendly atmosphere

Mainly locals and expats, writes one guest. 4 Google reviews mention a friendly bar.

Live music

5 Google reviews mention live music, 3 live events. One guest heard a singer and then karaoke.

Good beer prices

One guest found the beer prices really good, and they brought some nuts too.

In Pegeia

On the corner of Synergatismou street (E709) in Pegeia. Open every day 11:00-01:00. Call 26 621550.
